operations.label: Runtime raster-filter integration gap detected
operations.evidence: The standalone raster guard passed preflight tests, but the downloaded TIFF value array was not yet guaranteed to use the official EA NoData sentinel filter at measurement runtime.

operations.label: Fail-closed runtime guard injector implemented
operations.evidence: A slot-scoped Python injector adds guarded carrier patches for classic TIFF header validation and official EA NoData filtering on the real raster value array.

operations.label: Runtime guard injector deterministic test completed
operations.evidence: Local deterministic checks covered duplicate markers, both TIFF endiannesses, sentinel insertion and task-version upgrade.

operations.label: Hash-bound runtime carrier handoff implemented

operations.evidence: PowerShell independently requires positive feature_count, unique_identifier_count equal to feature_count and a 64-character identifier-set SHA-256.

operations.label: Runtime injector v1.2 deterministic verification completed
